summary: VersaBank filed a 6-K disclosing a Reorganization Agreement with newly formed Delaware parent Versa Bancorp for a holding-company reorganization. VersaBank shareholders will exchange common shares for exchangeable shares and ultimately Versa Bancorp stock, subject to Bank Act approvals and a special meeting. The deal involves a stated capital reduction, return of capital, related-party asset transactions, and sale of VersaHoldings US Corp. for a note. Terms include no price/share, premium, or valuation. Watch for regulatory clearance, shareholder vote, and the mechanics of the exchangeable-share structure.
